task: Extract matching rows from procurement tables
query_wording: Which Kenyan education procurement plans mention tablets or digital content? Show the package description, procurement method, and estimated cost.

turns.user: Which Kenyan education procurement plans mention tablets or digital content? Show the package description, procurement method, and estimated cost.

expected_sources.note: On 2026-11-22 the education projects with plans are P146797 (PRIEDE, 21 plans), P160083 (SEQIP, 55), P176867 (PEEL, 18), P174059 (COVID-19 Learning Continuity, 5) and P501648 (Secondary Education Equity, 4).

expected_sources.role: Kenya GPE Primary Education Development Project (PRIEDE): plans include school tablets
Kenya GPE COVID-19 Learning Continuity in Basic Education: plans include digital content packages
Latest PRIEDE plan: tablet package in the textual plan and in the STEP table
Latest COVID-19 Learning Continuity plan: digital content packages
Earlier PRIEDE plan with the same tablet package (most PRIEDE plan versions from 2017 on carry it)

text: Of the five Kenyan education projects with public procurement plans (PRIEDE P146797, SEQIP P160083, PEEL P176867, COVID-19 Learning Continuity P174059, Secondary Education Equity P501648; about 100 plans), two projects' plans have tablet or digital content packages. Amounts are in US$.
1. Kenya GPE Primary Education Development Project (PRIEDE, P146797). The package appears in most of its plan versions from 2017 to 2021; latest plan dated 2021-06-14 (STEP50499):

- Textual plan for 2016/2017, item 17: "Purchase of School Tablets, Development and Installation of the Software, Training on usage of school tablets and distribution of tablets to schools", estimated cost 1,189,982, method NCB (p. 3).

- STEP table, KE-MOE-8201-GO-RFB, same description: Request for Bids, Open - National, prior review; estimated amount 2,338,446.73, actual (contract) amount 2,257,188.03, status Signed (p. 7). The estimate and the signed amount are different figures and should not be mixed up.

2. Kenya GPE COVID-19 Learning Continuity in Basic Education Project (P174059), latest plan dated 2021-06-14 (STEP50498), Component 1 (remote learning), estimated amounts with no contract amount yet recorded (pp. 8-9):

- KE-LCBEP-201228-NC-RFB Upgrading of Kenya Education Cloud (content acquisition for Grade 4 in 10 learning areas), integrated LMS and school management system, databases for graphics, video and audio elements, radio and TV programmes, acquisition of server: Request for Bids, Open - National, 1,470,000 (p. 9).
- KE-LCBEP-201226-NC-RFB Producers of all curriculum subjects for content production: Request for Bids, Open - National, 350,000 (p. 8).
- KE-LCBEP-201217-GO-RFB Digital archiving (video and audio materials repository): Request for Bids, Open - National, 150,000 (p. 8).
- KE-LCBEP-201224-GO-RFB Licenses for proprietary software for graphics, video and audio elements: Request for Bids, Open - National, 100,000 (p. 8).

- KE-LCBEP-206340-NC-RFQ Platform digitization services for textbook evaluation: Request for Quotations, Limited, 90,000 (p. 8); KE-LCBEP-201210-GO-RFQ content refurbishment, dubbing and duplicating systems: RFQ, Limited, 50,000 (p. 8); KE-LCBEP-201232-NC-RFB Digitization of textbook evaluation, 180,000, cancelled (p. 8).

The SEQIP, PEEL and Secondary Education Equity plans list ICT equipment such as laptops but no tablets or digital content. One file filed under SEQIP (34106353, 2023-05-20) mentions tablets, but its pages are an Ethiopia project's plan (DRIVE, P176517), not a Kenyan one.
Coverage: this reads the latest plan of each project and spot-checks earlier versions; earlier versions may show different estimates for the same package.

right_sources: Reads the procurement plans of the Kenyan education projects and finds the PRIEDE (P146797) tablet package and the P174059 digital content packages.
grounded: Descriptions, methods and amounts match the plan tables, with the plan and page cited; the estimated amount is kept separate from the actual/contract amount; nothing from the misfiled Ethiopia plan is attributed to Kenya.
complete: For each matching package gives description, procurement method and estimated cost (with currency).
scoped: States how many plans or projects were checked (e.g. latest plan per project) and that the result covers those plans only.

notes: All matching projects are closed, so no new plans are expected. Plan versions repeat packages; listing a package once with the plan version used is enough.
